register.name: SYDEREP
register.numberFormat: IDU/UIN — unique identifier issued per EPR scheme
register.notes: Portal live (fetched 2026-08-16). The UIN must be displayed on marketplaces / in general terms of sale. Registration happens through the PRO (e.g. CITEO), which reports to SYDEREP and triggers issuance of the IDU; no separate state registration fee.

pro.ecoModulation: CITEO 2026: bonuses (e.g. −10% weight-based discount for >50% recycled fibre in paper-cardboard) and per-rate maluses; non-recyclable resins pay steeply more (PVC 2.10 €/kg vs PE/PP 0.77 €/kg).

notes: Rates are the weight-based part of CITEO's official 2026 Household Packaging Rate Guide (fetched 2026-08-16): steel 0.065, aluminium 0.243 ('metal' shows aluminium), paper-cardboard 0.258, beverage cartons 0.468 (used as 'composite'), glass 0.020, wood/cork 0.258 €/kg; plastics range 0.70 (clear PET bottles) – 0.77 (PE/PP) – 0.84 (rigid PET/flexible PP) – 1.40 (composite resins) – 2.10 (PVC) €/kg; 'plastic' shows the common PE/PP rate 0.77. IMPORTANT: total CITEO contribution = per-CSU (consumer sales unit) amount + this weight-based amount, so effective €/kg is higher for lightweight items. Shared minimum invoice fee €110/yr (covers packaging + graphic paper).
